events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Toronto’s Dylan Cease worked eight no-hit innings against the San Francisco Giants on Wednesday before allowing a single to Heliot...
headlines.shortLinkText: Blue Jays' Dylan Cease loses no-hit bid in 9th inning of 10-0 win over Giants

headlines.description: — Pete Crow-Armstrong hit two of Chicago's five home runs and the Cubs outslugged the Baltimore Orioles 9-7 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Crow-Armstrong hits 2 of Chicago's 5 homers and Cubs outslug Baltimore Orioles 9-7

headlines.description: — Jake Rogers and Spencer Torkelson homered and the Detroit Tigers won their fourth straight game, beating the Athletics 6-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jake Rogers, Spencer Torkelson homer as Tigers keep winning, beating Athletics 6-1

headlines.description: — Joey Bart hit a two-run home run with two outs in the eighth inning, lifting the NL East-leading Atlanta Braves to a 3-0 win over his former team on Wednesday after Pittsburgh Pirates starter Jared Jones pitched six perfect innings before being lifted.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bart's 2-run homer helps Atlanta to 3-0 win after Braves end Pirates' combined perfect-game bid

events.name: New York Yankees at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Jonathan Aranda drove in three runs, Shane McClanahan pitched 6 1/3 innings and the Tampa Bay Rays beat the New York Yankees 3-0 on Wednesday night to extend their AL East lead to five games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rays beat the Yankees 3-0 to extend AL East lead to 5 games

headlines.description: — Kyle Stowers homered, major league batting leader Otto López had his 40th multi-hit game and the Miami Marlins beat the Seattle Mariners 2-0 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stowers homers, López has 40th multi-hit game as Marlins beat Mariners 2-0 for 5th straight win

headlines.description: — CJ Abrams and Luis García Jr. both hit their 20th homers of the season, and the Washington Nationals pounded the Houston Astros 8-2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: CJ Abrams, Luis García Jr. both hit their 20th homers as the Nationals rout the Astros 8-2

headlines.description: — Sal Stewart hit two homers — including one when Cincinnati went deep four times in the fourth inning — Noelvi Marte drove in four runs and the Reds defeated the...
headlines.shortLinkText: Stewart homers twice, Reds go deep 5 times in 11-5 victory over Phillies

events.name: Kansas City Royals at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Jared Young was plunked with the bases loaded in the eighth inning, sparking a five-run rally that lifted the New York Mets to a 6-2 win over the Kansas City Royals on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jared Young hit by a pitch with the bases loaded, ignites a 5-run eighth as Mets beat Royals 6-2

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Jake Bennett allowed four hits in seven innings, Tsung-Che Cheng had his first multi-RBI game and the Boston Red Sox beat the Chicago White Sox 5-0 on Wednesday night for their fifth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bennett, Cheng lead the Red Sox past the White Sox, 5-0

headlines.description: — Alan Roden hit a game-winning RBI single in the ninth inning as the Minnesota Twins beat Cleveland 6-5 on Wednesday night for their fourth straight win over the Guardians.
headlines.shortLinkText: Roden's RBI single in the 9th inning lifts Twins past the Guardians 6-5

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Alec Burleson and José Fermín homered, Michael McGreevy worked 6 1/3 strong innings and the St. Louis Cardinals snapped a seven-game losing streak against Milwaukee with a 5-1 win over the Brewers on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Burleson, Fermín homers power Cardinals to a 5-1 win that snapped 8-game skid against Brewers

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Mike Trout hit a two-run homer in his return rom the injured list, Jo Adell had two home runs and drove in a career-high five runs and the Los Angeles Angels beat the Texas Rangers 13-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trout homers in return from IL, Adell hits 2 HRs as Angels beat Rangers 13-1

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at San Diego Padres

headlines.description: — Luis Campusano homered, Miguel Andujar had a career-high three doubles along with two RBI and the San Diego Padres beat the Arizona Diamondbacks 10-4 on Wednesday night to get back to .500.
headlines.shortLinkText: Campusano, Andujar help King, Padres beat Diamondbacks 10-4

events.name: Colorado Rockies at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Mookie Betts singled in the go-ahead run with two strikes in the eighth inning, lifting the Los Angeles Dodgers to a 4-3 victory over the Colorado Rockies on Wednesday night in the series finale.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mookie Betts delivers a clutch 2-strike hit in the eighth as Dodgers beat Rockies 4-3
